texts.preamble: Prahlad Singh vs Panchayat And Rural Development ... on 24 July, 2018 1 Wp-16238-20 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Wp-16238-2018 (Prahlad Singh Vs Panchayat And Rural Development Department) Indore, Dated : 24-07-2018
texts.facts: The petitioner has filed the present petition being aggrieved by the order 29.05.2018 by which he has been placed under suspension and order dated 02.07.2018 by which leanred Commissioner has declined to grant the interim injunction. The petitioner has assailed the said order mainly on the ground that he has been placed under suspension in exercise of power conferred under Section 39(1) (A) of the M.P. Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993.
